subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent schema and read-only planning contract as the foundation for the linked lifecycle stack?
rationale: The patch creates durable package, CLI, ownership, validation, and consent-integrity concepts; code correctness cannot determine whether those should become supported OpenClaw product contracts while the RFC remains unaccepted.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Approve the RFC contract, require exact-head safety-path proof, and then review this PR as the first experimental implementation slice.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce the first schema to the ownership surfaces maintainers are ready to support and defer unsettled package, MCP, cron, or identity semantics.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep this PR and its downstream stack open without landing until implementation experience resolves the remaining lifecycle and compatibility choices.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC contract, require exact-head safety-path proof, and then review this PR as the first experimental implementation slice.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the most detailed visible product-model and schema review adopted by both this branch and the current RFC.
